title: WHY AI!?
text:
I have loved using Daylio consistently for years. I love all of their updated and additional customization. I love the layout and I love the concept. I’ve used it to journal my habits and track my inner thoughts…

So having AI prompt me questions based off of my habits is very scary. How much of my data is being shared? And how could it be used against us in the future? And why AI? General prompts are great but the uber specific questions are concerning. This app was great without it. It’s sad to see the use of AI in a journaling app.

title: New look is awful.
text: I have loved this app for years. The newest update though has ruined the look. It’s terrible. I don’t like anything about it. Please give an option to have the classic look back. The bubbles around the tasks is distracting.

title: “New crisp look” visual update issue
text: I love this app and have adored it for years, but the current “crisp look” update is unpleasant to the eyes, the way the mood is bold white and taking space while the entries are a dim grey and cramped below hurts my eyes and I mean it in a serious way, the mood title’s white is too bright compared to the low opacity of the entry words itself. And I don’t like how the single pictures are now cropped by default unlike before where the square single pictures showed fully. Please at least let us have the choice to revert to the old look. The new update is a bit off putting to my eyes i’m considering stopping my entries after 2000+ entries because of it :(

title: PDF
text: The app’s functionality is excellent, but I’m disappointed with the redesigned PDF export. It looks unattractive and is difficult to read. The oversized dates take up far too much space on the page and distract from the important information in the notes, activity icons, and charts.

title: Be careful with the annual subscription!
text:
Be very careful before starting the free trial! The app only offers an annual subscription, with no monthly option. I forgot to cancel my trial, but canceled immediately on the same day I was charged and requested a refund through Apple. Apple denied my request, and even after contacting support, they refused to offer any solution, not even a partial refund for the unused months.

Now I’m stuck paying for an entire year of an app I don’t want to use. I’m sharing my experience so other people don’t end up in the same situation. Very frustrating and disappointing!

title: Difficult to Unsubscribe
text: I think the app is made well enough for what it is, but after it prompts you to agree to its one week free trial it really needs to provide more clear information on how to unsubscribe from it. I ended up having to email support and put in a refund request through Apple.
